counterfactual_missing_items: histopathological examination of the mass-like prominence
thyroid function tests to assess the functional status of the ectopic tissue
decisive_items: Neck ultrasound failed to identify the thyroid gland in its normal pretracheal location
several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue, and no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location
response.rationale: R2 and C1 both suggest ectopic thyroid tissue, but R2 has more comprehensive support from imaging findings and laboratory results, while C1 is an append-only completion of R2 with similar but less detailed support

rejected.why: R1 is less likely due to the presence of multiple nodular structures and the absence of the thyroid gland in the usual neck location, which is more consistent with ectopic thyroid tissue than a thyroglossal duct cyst
